text: This Report responds to an application where staff are currently not in a position to provide a Final Report to Council, but which could be appealed to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal ("LPAT") due to a lack of decision during the break in Council's meeting schedule (July to December 2018). The report sets out outstanding issues related to the application and makes an initial determination as to whether or not the application is consistent with the Provincial Policy Statement (2014) and conforms with the Growth Plan for the Greater Golden Horseshoe (2017). This application proposes the expansion of the existing Briton House Retirement Centre. The proposed expansion consists of a 25-storey building (88.6 metres including mechanical penthouse) including a seven-storey base building. City Council direct the City Solicitor and appropriate City Staff to attend and oppose the application in its current form, should the application be appealed to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal on the basis of City Council's failure to make a decision on the application within the statutory timeframe of the Planning Act. 3.
